cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.

mechanism: A treats its photography pupil blinking and time objections as reasons to add a rota, rehearsal and timekeeper rather than take the photograph.
confusable: Not merely offering a practical fix: each barrier produces an extra rule or overseer before the same simple task.
comparison: Pouring oversight versus photo preparation becoming monitored rehearsal.
seedUse: D192 failed family photo/blink schedule/rehearsal/duration; S05 count-before-shutter teaching.
